messages.subject: Five-a-side Thursday?
messages.plaintextBody:
James - are you in for five-a-side this Thursday at Shoreditch? We're a man short after Tom pulled his hamstring. 7pm kickoff. Pint after at the Crown.

Marcus

[Apologies if this is the wrong James - got the address from the league sheet!]
